title: Frame fitting uses the cluster's own padding, diverging from Mermaid 12's 24px

v:
## Context

Mermaid 12.2.0's ELK adapter fits each subgraph's frame after layout (`evenGroupFrames`, `elk-V4PLJRSU.mjs` line 99981). It pulls the frame's left, right and bottom sides in to `SUBGRAPH_PADDING` beyond what the frame holds, a fixed 24px (line 99194), and never makes the frame narrower than `groupTitleWidth`: the title's width plus the subgraph's padding once (line 99267).

Siren ports the pass into the shared layout core (`fitFrames` in `layout/directedGraph/layoutDirectedGraph.ts`, under rule 2 of `01M4VANRC6B2C14NHVC2KRZ9Y8`). Siren's frame is not built like Mermaid's. Its title band is part of the frame's top padding: the cluster's padding, the title's height, and the padding again (`clusterShape`). The flowchart adapter's cluster padding is 12.

## Decision

`fitFrames` pulls a frame in to the cluster's own padding (12 in the flowchart), not to Mermaid's 24. Its width floor is the title's width plus twice the padding, the same floor `clusterShape` asks ELK for, not Mermaid's title plus the padding once. This diverges from Mermaid under rule 1 of `01M4VANRC6B2C14NHVC2KRZ9Y8`.

## Evidence

Parity, the 11 flowchart fixtures (garden-network, street-fair, dense-24/36/50, edge-labels, example-flowchart-edges, long-edges, subgraph-direction-crossing, subgraph-direction-isolated, subgraph-no-direction-isolated), Mermaid 12.2.0 against Siren in headless Chrome, pooled:

- Cluster padding passed to `fitFrames`: vertical agreement 99.6%, horizontal 97.8%.
- 24 passed instead: vertical 99.1%, horizontal 97.8%.

Passing 24 makes the vertical agreement worse because Siren's title band uses the padding twice. With 24 the band grows by 24px against Mermaid's, and boxes below a titled frame move down against their neighbours.

## Consequences

A Siren frame sits closer to what it holds than Mermaid's frame does: 12px on the left, right and bottom against Mermaid's 24px. A frame whose title is wider than its members is one padding wider than Mermaid's. If the title band is ever rebuilt to match Mermaid's, measure again before changing the padding.
